csv_project_name: AE Services for AL- Sheetz Center Entrepreneurial Excellence
csv_agency: Penn State University-Office of Physical Plant
csv_scope_of_work: The Pennsylvania State University (PSU) is excited to begin the Architecture/Engineering (A/E) Team selection process for the Sheetz Center for Entrepreneurial Excellence Expansion project, located in downtown Altoona at 1309 11th Avenue. PSU is utilizing its standard qualification-based A/E Team selection process for this project. The Sheetz Center for Entrepreneurial Excellence (SCCE) is the vision of Steve and Nancy Sheetz with the mission to provide entrepreneurial education for Penn State Altoona students and the surrounding community through classroom and experiential training. The existing 14,550 sf building consists of classrooms, conference rooms, offices, and other supportive spaces for the Sheetz Center. The program has grown from 8 students in 2012 to approximately 30 40 students per class and has outgrown the capacity of the existing facility. With the continuing generous support of the Sheetz family an expansion project is envisioned to serve the anticipated increased enrollment of the program. New Construction Scope: A 2023 feasibility study by Weber Murphy Fox (to be shared with long-listed firms) outlines a preliminary program and scope, to be validated as part of this project. The draft program includes approximately 8,700 sf of new construction and features the following: A new main entrance Collaborative classroom and event space with flexible seating for approximately 250 people Active learning spaces for group and individual study, gathering, and lounging A space for the Ivyside Eats food pantry Additional office space for faculty and staff Utility support spaces. Renovation Scope: Approximately 5,700 sf of the existing building has been identified as a priority for renovation as part of the project. The project will also include the option for removal and replacement of existing roofing and roof top mechanical equipment.
csv_disciplines_requested: Architecture Services, Rehabilitation & Refurbishment, Civil Engineering, Geotechnical Engineering, Feasibility Studies, Electrical Engineering, Fire Protection Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Structural Engineering, Utility Engineering, Traffic Design Engineering, Urban Studies/Planning/Design
